# SAGMOTO

> SAGMOTO is a brand of Shaanxi Automobile Group (SAG), one of China's leading commercial vehicle manufacturers. SAGMOTO produces a comprehensive range of heavy-duty, medium-duty, and light-duty trucks including dump trucks, tractor trucks, cargo trucks, and special-purpose vehicles. Models include X3s, E3, E1st, Z3, X6, X6s, X7, X9, X9s, E9, E6, X5, i9, i5. Engines: Cummins (ISME, ISM, M13, Z14, ISD), Weichai (WP10, WP12), Yuchai (YC6MK, YC4E, YC4D). Emissions: Euro II, Euro III, Euro V, Euro VI. Drive configurations: 4x2, 6x4, 8x4, 4x4, 6x6.

## Products

- [Heavy Duty Trucks](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/products.html?cat=heavy): E1st, Z3, E3, E9 - Heavy-duty trucks for mining, construction, and long-haul logistics
- [Medium Duty Trucks](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/products.html?cat=medium): E6, X6, X5 - Medium-duty trucks for regional transport and municipal applications

- [Off-Road Trucks](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/products.html?cat=offroad): X3s, Off-road Dump - Off-road and mining dump trucks
- [X1s Mining Dump Truck](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/x1s.html): 6x4 mining dump truck with Weichai WP10 350HP engine
- [New Energy Vehicles](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/new-energy.html): Electric trucks including i5 and i9 models
- [SAGMOTO X3s](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/x3s.html): X3s tractor truck 6x4 380HP, dump truck, cargo truck, mixer truck - Cummins/Weichai engine
- [SAGMOTO E3](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/e3.html): E3 economy tractor truck 6x4 380HP - Weichai WP10 engine

- [SAGMOTO i9](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/i9.html): i9 electric truck - 430km range, 120KW fast charge, zero emission
- [SAGMOTO i5](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/i5.html): i5 electric light truck - city logistics, last-mile delivery

- [SAGMOTO E9](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/e9.html): E9 light duty - cargo, dump - 4x2/4x4
- [SAGMOTO X5](https://sagmoto-trucks.com/x5.html): X5 medium duty - cargo, dump - 4x2/6x4

## Company
